name: Enigmatica 9
author: justmikey2002@gmail.com
description:
Enigmatica 9 (Minecraft 1.19.2, Forge) server. Installs the official Enigmatica 9 server pack from
CurseForge using its bundled ServerStarter in install-only mode, then launches Forge directly so
the panel console, stop command and startup detection all work. Reinstalling cleanly replaces
mods, configs and scripts while keeping the world.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Enigmatica 9 installation script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail
echo "=== Enigmatica 9 egg install script (version 2026-09-27 r4: per-file overrides output) ==="

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl unzip ca-certificates > /dev/null

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

PACK_URL="${SERVER_PACK_URL:-https://edge.forgecdn.net/files/8161/107/Enigmatica9Server-1.27.0.zip}"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reinstall: clear everything the pack manages so no stale or duplicated
# config survives (worlds, server.properties, ops, whitelist are kept).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ -f serverstarter.lock ] || [ -d mods ]; then
  echo "Existing install found - cleaning pack-managed files (world is kept)"
  if [ "${BACKUP_CONFIGS:-1}" = "1" ] && [ -d config ]; then
    BACKUP="config-backup-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).tar.gz"
    echo "Backing up config, defaultconfigs and kubejs to ${BACKUP}"
    tar -czf "${BACKUP}" --ignore-failed-read config defaultconfigs kubejs 2> /dev/null || true
  fi
  rm -rf mods config defaultconfigs kubejs libraries serverstarter.lock unix_args.txt run.sh run.bat
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Download and unpack the server pack
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "Downloading server pack: ${PACK_URL}"
rm -rf /tmp/serverpack /tmp/serverpack.zip
curl -fL --retry 3 -o /tmp/serverpack.zip "${PACK_URL}"
mkdir -p /tmp/serverpack
unzip -o -q /tmp/serverpack.zip -d /tmp/serverpack

SETUP_FILE=$(find /tmp/serverpack -maxdepth 3 -name server-setup-config.yaml | head -n 1)
if [ -z "${SETUP_FILE}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: server-setup-config.yaml not found in the server pack. Is SERVER_PACK_URL a server pack?"
  exit 1
fi
cp -a "$(dirname "${SETUP_FILE}")/." /mnt/server/

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Get ServerStarter (bundled, or the version start-server.sh asks for)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
STARTER_JAR=$(ls serverstarter-*.jar 2> /dev/null | head -n 1 || true)
if [ -z "${STARTER_JAR}" ]; then
  STARTER_JAR=$(grep -ohE 'serverstarter-[0-9.]+\.jar' start-server.sh 2> /dev/null | head -n 1 || true)
  STARTER_JAR="${STARTER_JAR:-serverstarter-2.4.0.jar}"
  STARTER_VER=$(echo "${STARTER_JAR}" | sed -E 's/serverstarter-([0-9.]+)\.jar/\1/')
  echo "Downloading ${STARTER_JAR}"
  curl -fL --retry 3 -o "${STARTER_JAR}" \
    "https://github.com/EnigmaticaModpacks/ServerStarter/releases/download/v${STARTER_VER}/${STARTER_JAR}"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Download the client pack (manifest.json + overrides/) ourselves, so we know
# it arrived. ServerStarter silently skips it if its own download fails.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cp server-setup-config.yaml /tmp/server-setup-config.yaml.orig
MODPACK_URL="${CLIENT_PACK_URL:-}"
if [ -z "${MODPACK_URL}" ]; then
  MODPACK_URL=$(grep -E '^[[:space:]]*modpackUrl:' server-setup-config.yaml | head -n 1 \
    | sed -E "s/^[[:space:]]*modpackUrl:[[:space:]]*//; s/^['\"]//; s/['\"][[:space:]]*$//; s/[[:space:]]+$//")
fi
if [ -z "${MODPACK_URL}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: no client pack URL (modpackUrl missing from server-setup-config.yaml; set CLIENT_PACK_URL)"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Downloading client pack: ${MODPACK_URL}"
rm -rf /tmp/clientpack /tmp/clientpack.zip
curl -fL --retry 3 -o /tmp/clientpack.zip "${MODPACK_URL}"
if ! unzip -l /tmp/clientpack.zip manifest.json > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: ${MODPACK_URL} is not a CurseForge pack zip (no manifest.json)"
  exit 1
fi
# Point ServerStarter at the local copy so it doesn't download it a second time
sed -i -E "s#^([[:space:]]*modpackUrl:).*#\1 file:///tmp/clientpack.zip#" server-setup-config.yaml

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Install mods + Forge (install-only mode exits instead of launching)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "Running ${STARTER_JAR} in install-only mode (downloads mods and Forge; this takes a while)"
# stdin from /dev/null: ServerStarter asks for the EULA and would wait forever in the
# installer. The panel's EULA prompt handles acceptance on first start instead.
java -jar "${STARTER_JAR}" install < /dev/null
cp /tmp/server-setup-config.yaml.orig server-setup-config.yaml

FORGE_ARGS=$(find libraries/net/minecraftforge/forge -name unix_args.txt 2> /dev/null | head -n 1 || true)
if [ -z "${FORGE_ARGS}" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: Forge did not install (unix_args.txt missing). Check the output above."
  exit 1
fi
cp "${FORGE_ARGS}" unix_args.txt

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Force-copy the pack's overrides/ over the server (replaces the manual upload).
# Client-only folders are skipped, same list as the pack's own server config.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "Applying pack overrides (config, defaultconfigs, kubejs, ...)"
mkdir -p /tmp/clientpack
echo "[overrides] client pack zip: $(du -h /tmp/clientpack.zip | cut -f1), $(unzip -Z1 /tmp/clientpack.zip 'overrides/*' 2> /dev/null | grep -vc '/$') files inside overrides/"

# Heartbeat: prints the running file count every 10s, so a stall is obvious
( while sleep 10; do
    echo "[overrides] still working... $(find /tmp/clientpack -type f 2> /dev/null | wc -l) files extracted so far"
  done ) &
HEARTBEAT=$!
trap 'kill ${HEARTBEAT} 2> /dev/null || true' EXIT

echo "[overrides] step 1/2: extracting"
unzip -o /tmp/clientpack.zip 'overrides/*' \
  -x 'overrides/local/*' 'overrides/packmenu/*' 'overrides/resources/*' \
     'overrides/kubejs/assets/*' 'overrides/kubejs/client_scripts/*' \
     'overrides/building_gadgets_patterns/*' \
     'overrides/config/*-client.toml' 'overrides/defaultconfigs/*-client.toml' \
  -d /tmp/clientpack < /dev/null
if [ ! -d /tmp/clientpack/overrides ]; then
  echo "ERROR: client pack has no overrides/ folder"
  exit 1
fi

echo "[overrides] step 2/2: copying into the server folder"
cp -av /tmp/clientpack/overrides/. /mnt/server/ < /dev/null | sed -E "s#^'?/tmp/clientpack/overrides/\./?#  copied: #; s#' -> .*##"
kill "${HEARTBEAT}" 2> /dev/null || true
for d in config kubejs; do
  if [ -z "$(ls -A "$d" 2> /dev/null)" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: ${d}/ is empty after applying overrides"
    exit 1
  fi
done
echo "Overrides applied: $(find /tmp/clientpack/overrides -type f | wc -l) files"
rm -rf /tmp/clientpack /tmp/clientpack.zip /tmp/server-setup-config.yaml.orig

rm -rf /tmp/serverpack /tmp/serverpack.zip
echo "Enigmatica 9 install complete ($(ls mods | wc -l) mods)"

variables.name: Server Pack URL
variables.description:
Direct download link to the Enigmatica 9 server pack zip. Defaults to Enigmatica9Server-1.27.0.
To update, paste the new server file's link and use Settings > Reinstall Server. The Expert
pack's server zip works here too.

variables.name: Back Up Configs On Reinstall
variables.description:
1 = save config, defaultconfigs and kubejs to a config-backup-*.tar.gz before a reinstall wipes
them. 0 = no backup.

variables.name: Client Pack URL (optional)
variables.description:
Leave blank to use the pack zip listed in the server pack (manifest.json + overrides). Only set this
to force a different Enigmatica9-x.y.z.zip; its overrides/ folder is copied over the server on
every install.
